changelog: **Mail delivery: queue operations, alerts and a mail sink for PR environments (#2953):** `/api/health?jobs=1` carries a `mail` block for an operator (the `HEALTH_TOKEN` holder or a super admin, never a tenant ADMIN) — pending and the oldest wait per lane (lane read from `Job.priority`), running, `deferred24h`, dead letters, `failed24h`, the relay pause per channel (`paused`, `pausedUntil`, `pauseLevel`, `outageSec`) and today's count against `MAIL_DAILY_CAP`; counts and ages only. Settings → Email deliverability gains a *Queue* tab (`GET /api/admin/mail-queue`, `POST /api/admin/mail-queue/[id]/retry` and `/cancel`) for a super admin (their world) or the default organization's ADMIN (its own rows and org-less mail) — every other admin gets 403 `mail_queue_operator_only`; rows show lane, category, product, attempts, a reason code and a 12-character recipient-hash prefix, never an address. Retry (FAILED/DEAD_LETTER → PENDING, attempts reset, only before `notAfter` and while the envelope is present) and cancel (PENDING → CANCELLED, envelope cleared) are one guarded `updateMany` with the AuditLog row in the same transaction plus an ActivityLog line. A FAILED or DEAD_LETTER mail now keeps its sealed envelope until its `notAfter` (at most 72 h), then the drain's housekeeping clears it. Three operator alerts with hourly `ops:<kind>:<hour>` keys run after each drain tick: oldest CRITICAL mail pending > 5 min, relay refusing > 15 min (new nullable `MailBudget.pausedSince`, an expand-only push) and rejected SMTP credentials (EAUTH); the daily dead-letter alert names mail rows and the Queue tab. With `MAIL_SINK_HOST` set, every mail whose recipients are not all on `MAIL_RECIPIENT_ALLOWLIST` goes to that SMTP sink instead of the relay — an unreachable sink queues and retries, never falls back; `infra/server/topic-deploy.sh` starts one shared, loopback-only Mailpit container for all topic environments, and `infra/server/demo-refresh.sh` runs the demo with `MAIL_WORKER_ENABLED=0`. Rules are pure in `src/lib/mailOpsRule.ts` and `src/lib/mailSinkRule.ts` (`scripts/test/mail-ops.test.mjs`); `e2e/mail-queue-admin.spec.ts`, `e2e/mail-ops.spec.ts` and the authz matrix cover the routes, the scope, the sink and the alerts.

en: Administrators who run the installation can now see the outgoing mail queue under Settings → Email deliverability → Queue: what is waiting, what could not be delivered, and whether the mail server is pausing. Undelivered mail can be retried and waiting mail cancelled.
tr: Kurulumu yöneten yöneticiler artık giden e-posta kuyruğunu Ayarlar → E-posta ulaşılabilirliği → Kuyruk altında görebilir: neyin beklediğini, neyin teslim edilemediğini ve posta sunucusunun duraklayıp duraklamadığını. Teslim edilemeyen e-postalar yeniden denenebilir, bekleyenler iptal edilebilir.
de: Administratoren, die die Installation betreiben, sehen die ausgehende E-Mail-Warteschlange jetzt unter Einstellungen → E-Mail-Zustellbarkeit → Warteschlange: was wartet, was nicht zugestellt werden konnte und ob der Mailserver pausiert. Nicht zugestellte E-Mails lassen sich erneut versuchen, wartende stornieren.
